title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face, and within this face, create a single loop. In this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0144, 0.0144] with a radius of 0.0144. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0288 to the two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by a depth of 0.75, ensuring that the operation creates a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are length 0.02884615384615384, width 0.02884615384615384, and height 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch on the XY plane
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0144, 0.0144)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0144)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
